title: Cross-hand grip trial-profile concordance did not establish incremental DSST prediction beyond strength, asymmetry and variability
abstract: In complete-case adults60–79, adding a three-trial cross-hand profile concordance spline to conventional covariates and grip summaries did not establish improved DSST prediction from NHANES2011–2012 (n=964) to NHANES2013–2014 (n=1097). Weighted baseline-minus-augmented MSE was -0.81697 correct-symbols² (95% source+target PSU-refit interval -7.06597 to 1.79192). This is a model-specific negative test,not equivalence or a biological null.
